data.narrative:
DroneShield is a public-stage defense and security company founded by Brian Hearing and John Franklin, having raised over $100M to date. The valuation universe comprises 26 same-sector peers, though the narrow peer set suitable for direct comparison is constrained: 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. A same-stage and adjacent-stage peer filter yielded fewer than three datapoints—specifically, one same-stage comparable and zero adjacent-stage peers—falling below the minimum threshold of three observations required for reliable median calculation. An all-sector median approach would introduce substantial category drift and produce misleading results, as the 26 Defense & Security peers span heterogeneous business models, technology maturity, and customer bases that do not reflect DroneShield's specific operational and financial profile.

Without sufficient narrow peer density, triangulation methods cannot be reliably executed. A defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the available data. Progression toward a credible estimate would require either: (1) expansion of the peer set to include adjacent defense-tech verticals with documented financials, (2) acquisition of current financial metrics from the identified private peers, or (3) deployment of alternative methods such as DCF or revenue multiple analysis using DroneShield's specific operating data.
